text.body: suvarṇamālāstutiḥ atha kathamapi madrasanāṃ tvaguṇaleśairviśodhayāmi vibho sāmba sadāśiva śambho śaṅkara śaraṇaṃ me tava caraṇayugam ॥ 1 ākhaṇḍala madakhaṇḍana paṇḍita taṇḍupriya caṇḍīśa vibho । sāmba ॥2 ibhacarmāṃbara śambararipurapaharaṇojvalanayana vibho । sāmba... ॥ 3 īśagirīśa nareśa pareśa maheśa bileśaya bhūṣaṇa bho । sāmba ॥4 umayā divyasumaṅgala vigrahayāssliṅgitavāmāṅga vibho । sāmba ...॥ 5 ūrīkuru māmajñamanāthaṃ dūrīkuru me duritaṃ bho । sāmba॥ 6 ṛṣivaramānasahaṃsacarācarajanana sthitilaya kāraṇa bho । sāmba ...॥ ṛkṣādhīśa kirīṭa mahokṣārūḍhavidhūtarudrākṣa vibho । sāmba ...॥ 8 lṛvarṇadvandvamavṛntasukusumamivāṅghrau tavārpayāmi vibho । sāmba ...॥ ekaṃ saditi śrutyā tvameva sadasītyupāsmahe mṛḍa bho । sāmba ...॥ aikyaṃ nijabhaktebhyo vitarasi viśvambharo'tra sākṣī bho । sāmba ... omiti tava nirdeṣṭrī māyāsmākaṃ mṛḍopakartri bho । sāmba ... ॥ 12 audāsyaṃ sphuṭayati viṣayeṣu digambaratā ca tavaiva vibho । sāmba ...॥ antaḥ karaṇaviśuddhiṃ bhaktiṃ ca svayi satī pradehi vibho । sāmba ...॥ astopādhisamastavyastairūpairjaganmayo'si vimo। sāmba ...॥ karuṇāvaruṇālaya mayi dāsa udāsastavocito nahi bho । sāmba ॥ khalasahavāsaṃ vighaṭaya ghaṭaya satāmeva saṅgamaniśaṃ bho । sāmba ... ॥ garalaṃ jagadupakṛtaye gilitaṃ bhavatā samo'ti ko'tra vibho । sāmba ...॥ ghanasrāragauragātrapracurajaṭājūṭabaddhagaṅga vibho । sāmba ... ॥ 19 jñaptiḥ sarvaśarīreṣvakhaṇḍitāyā vibhāti sātvaṃ bho। sāmba ॥20 capalaṃ mama hṛdayakapiṃ viṣayadrucaraṃ dṛḍhaṃ badhāna vibho । sāmba ... ॥ chāyāsthāṇorapi tava pāpaṃ namatāṃ haratyaho śiva bho । sāmba ॥ jayakailāsanivāsa pramathagaṇādhīśa bhūsurārcita bho । sāmba ..॥ jhaṇutaka iṅkiṇu jhaṇutatkiṭatakaśabdainaṭasimahānaṭa bho । sāmba.. jñānaṃ vikṣepādirahitaṃ kuru me gururutvameva vibho । sāmba ...॥ 25 ṭakkārastava dhanuṣo dalayati hṛdayaṃ dviṣasaśaniriva bho । sāmba ...॥ ṭākṛtiriva tavamāyābahirantaḥ śūnyarūpiṇī khalu bho । sāmba ...॥ ḍambasmamburuhāmapi dalayatyanaghaṃ tvadaṅghriyugalaṃ bho । sāmba । ... ॥ ḍhakkākṣasūtra śūladruhiṇakaroṭīsamullasatkara bho । sāmba...29 ṇākāragarbhiṇī cecchubhadā te śaragatirnṛṇāmiha bho । sāmba....॥ 30 tava manvatisañjapataḥ sadyastarati narohi bhavābdhiṃ bho । sāmba ...॥ dhūtkārastasya mukhe bhūyātte nāmanāsti yasya vibho । sāmba... ॥32 dayanīyaśca dayāluḥ ko'sti madanyastvadanya iha vada bho । sāmba dharmasthāpanadakṣatryakṣaguro dakṣayajñaśikṣaka bho । sāmba ...॥ 34 nanuvāḍito'si dhanuṣā lubdhadhiyā tvaṃ purā nareṇa vibho । sāmba.. parimātuṃ tava mūrtiṃ nālamajastatparātparo'si vibho । sāmba ...॥ phalamiha nṛtayā januṣastvatpadasevāsanātaneśa vibho । sāmba...॥ balamārogyaṃ cāyustvadguṇarucitāṃ ciraṃ pradehi vibho । sāmba ... bhagavan bharga bhayāpaha bhūtapate bhūtibhūṣitāṅga vibho । sāmba ...॥ 39 mahimā tava nahi māti śrutiṣu himānīdharātmajādhava bho। sāmba... yamaniyamādimiraṅgairyamino hṛdaye bhajanti satvaṃ bho । sāmba ...॥41 rajjāvahiriva śukto rajatamiva tvayi jaganti bhānti vibho । sāmba...॥ labdhvā bhavatprasādāccakaṃ vidhuravati lokamakhilaṃ bho। sānba vasudhātaddharacchayarathamaurvaśaraparākṛtāsura bho । sāmba ...॥ 44 śarvadeva sarvottama sarvada durvṛttagarvaharaṇa vibho । sāmba ... ॥ 45 ṣaḍripuṣaḍūrmi ṣaḍvikārahara sanmukha ṣaṇmukha janaka vibho । sāmba...॥ satyaṃ jñānamanantaṃ brahmetyetallakṣaṇalakṣita bho । sāmba ...॥ 47 hāhā hūhū mukha suragāyakagītāpadānapadya vibho । sāmba ... ॥ 48 lādirnahi prayogastadantamiha maṅgalaṃ sadāstu vibho । sāmba ... ॥ 41 kṣaṇamiva divasānneṣyati tvatpadasevākṣaṇotsukaḥ śiva bho । sāmba ... iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau ॥ suvarṇamālāstutiḥ sampūrṇā ॥
